sentences.en: Hideo turned the steering wheel sharply to avoid the bicyclist.
sentences.zh: 比ideo猛地转动方向盘避开了一名骑自行车的人。

sentences.en: The road bends sharply to the right at this point.
sentences.zh: 在这个地方，道路突然向右拐弯。

sentences.en: Public opinion has been sharply divided into supporters and opponents.
sentences.zh: 公众意见明显分裂为支持者和反对者两派。
